title: Tikkit · Service health
description: Container CPU and memory, service-wide RPC traffic, investigative failure percentage, latency and per-instance BEAM context. Pipeline sample age is not application availability. No formal SLO or alerts.

options.content:
**Scope:** All RPC actions, operations (run and validate), outcomes and instances in selected environments. RPC/BEAM environment is telemetry resource identity. RPC/DB distributions combine selected environments; BEAM gauges remain per environment and instance.

**Container attribution (Dokploy / Linux Swarm):** Set Docker labels `service.name` and `deployment.environment.name` for service/environment attribution. Service falls back to Swarm service, then container name; environment has no fallback. `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` does not automatically label Docker containers. Unlabelled-environment containers are visible only with Environment **All**, and still must match the selected service. The current local API container has no attribution labels or limits.

**Container interpretation:** CPU cores are used cores; CPU percentage is usage relative to configured **CFS quota**, not CPU shares or cpuset-only capacity. Memory is container **working set**, separate from BEAM allocated memory below, not identical to RSS. Unlimited, missing or unknown limits produce **no percentage**, never a fabricated zero. Container series retain container identity across replacement.

**Interpretation:** Internal/unclassified failure percentage is an investigative proxy, NOT a formal SLO. Expected validation and rate-limiting errors are excluded from its numerator. No data is unknown, never green; no traffic means undefined failure percentage and latency, not zero. Sparse histogram tails are noisy. Exemplars/traces are sampled; Explore logs are related service logs.

**PIPELINE sample age:** Prometheus sample age, not an application heartbeat or availability check; collectors may re-emit cached data. Missing instances can disappear after staleness, not recover.

**Deployments:** Tag annotations `tikkit-deployment`; they are shared across environments. Include environment and version in annotation text. No automated deploy integration yet.

**Gaps requiring instrumentation:** External availability probe; formal SLO/burn budget; container restarts/OOM events; PostgreSQL internals. No alerts configured.

panels.title: Container CPU used · cores
panels.description: Used CPU cores per container. Rate is applied to each total CPU counter before aggregation; max avoids adding duplicate collector series. One core means one CPU-second per second. Missing telemetry is unknown.

panels.title: Container CPU · % of CFS quota
panels.description: Used cores divided by configured CFS quota cores (positive quota / positive period), multiplied by 100. Matching container/container_id aggregation removes the cpu label mismatch. Missing or unlimited quotas have no percentage; CPU shares and cpuset-only capacity are not quota. Values are not clamped at 100%.

targets.expr: 100 * max by (container, container_id) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{service_name="$service",deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}",cpu="total"}[$__rate_interval])) / ((max by (container, container_id) (container_spec_cpu_quota{service_name="$service",deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) > 0) / (max by (container, container_id) (container_spec_cpu_period{service_name="$service",deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) > 0))

panels.title: Container memory working set · bytes
panels.description: Container cgroup working set in bytes, not BEAM allocated memory or identical to RSS. Includes memory beyond the BEAM allocator. Max preserves each container gauge without adding duplicate collector series. Missing telemetry is unknown, not zero.

panels.title: Container working set · % of memory limit
panels.description: Working set divided by a positive configured container memory limit, multiplied by 100. Zero (unlimited), missing or unknown limits produce no percentage. This is not BEAM allocator utilization. Values are not clamped at 100%.

panels.title: Total RPC throughput · all actions / operations / outcomes
panels.description: Total requests per second across selected environments and all instances. Includes run, validate, successes and failures. Missing telemetry is not synthesized as zero.

panels.title: Internal / unclassified RPC failures · %
panels.description: Investigative proxy, NOT a formal SLO. Numerator: success=false with internal_error, unknown_error or error. Expected validation/rate limiting excluded. Denominator: all RPCs. Zero requires an observed positive denominator; no traffic or absent denominator leaves the percentage undefined.

panels.title: Overall RPC latency · p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Milliseconds across all actions, operations, outcomes and instances in selected environments. Bucket rates summed by le before quantiles. No observations means undefined latency, not zero; sparse tail estimates are noisy.

panels.title: DB p95 · query / queue time
panels.description: Service/environment-wide repository histogram quantiles in milliseconds. Query and queue p95 are independent distributions; do not add them. No queries means undefined latency, not zero. This is application repository timing, not PostgreSQL internals.

panels.title: BEAM total run queues · per instance
panels.description: Total run queue length by environment and service instance. _ratio is an upstream naming artifact: values are counts, not percentages. Max preserves each instance gauge without adding duplicate collector series. No stacking or synthetic zeros.

panels.title: BEAM allocated memory · per instance
panels.description: BEAM allocated memory in bytes by environment and service instance, NOT container RSS. Max avoids adding duplicate collector series. Missing telemetry is unknown, not zero memory.

panels.title: PIPELINE sample age · seconds per instance
panels.description: time() minus the Prometheus timestamp of vm_memory_total_bytes, grouped by environment and service instance (oldest age if duplicated). This is pipeline sample age, NOT an application heartbeat: collectors may re-emit cached data. After staleness an instance may disappear; no data is unknown, never healthy.
